1 # 1 Te 1.1 Paulo ne Silwano ne Timoteo de kɔma Tesalonikafoɔ asafo wɔ yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo mu: 2#Rom 1.7 Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.
Aseda
3 # 2 Te 2.13; 1 Te 1.2-3 Anuanom, ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa sɛdeɛ ɛfata, mo nti, ɛfiri sɛ mo gyidie nyini boro so, na dɔ a mo nyinaa mode dodɔ mo ho mmaako mmaako no mu adɔ. 4#2 Ko 7.4 Mo boasetɔ ne gyidie a mokura mu, mo taa nyinaa ne amaneɛ a momiaa mo ani hunuiɛ no mu nti, ɛma yɛn ara yɛhoahoa yɛn ho ma mo wɔ Nyankopɔn asafo no mu. 5#Flp 1.28; Luk 21.36 Ɛno na ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn atɛntenenee agyiraeɛ, sɛ wɔbɛbu mo sɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie a mohunu ho amaneɛ no fata mo.
Kristo bɛba sɛ ɔtemmufoɔ
6 # Adi 18.6-7 Ɛfiri sɛ ɛtene Nyankopɔn anim sɛ ɔde ahohia tua wɔn a wɔhiahia mo ho no ka, 7#Mat 25.31 na wama mo a wɔhiahia mo ho no ne yɛn ahome, ɛda a wɔbɛyi Awurade Yesu ne ne tumi abɔfoɔ adie afiri soro, ogyaframa mu, 8#Rom 2.8 na watɔ wɔn a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn, na wɔantie yɛn Awurade Yesu asɛmpa no were. 9#Yes 2.10; 2.19 Wɔn na wɔbɛnya akatua a ɛyɛ daa ɔsɛeɛ, ne yi a wɔyi wɔn firi Awurade anim ne ne tumi animuonyam ho, 10#Kol 3.4 ɛberɛ a ɛbɛba sɛ wɔnhyɛ no animuonyam n’ahotefoɔ mu. Na wɔnhwɛ n’anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔagye adie nyinaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔagye yɛn adanseɛ a yɛdii mo no adi, ɛda no ara mu.
11Enti nso, yɛbɔ mpaeɛ ma mo daa, sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn mmu mo sɛ mosɛ ɔfrɛ no, na ɔmfa tumi so mma n’ayamyɛ anisɔdeɛ ne gyidie adwuma nyɛ ma, 12na wɔahyɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu din animuonyam wɔ mo mu, ne mo nso wɔ ne mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo adom no teɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo ne Silwano ne Timoteo de kɔma Tesalonikafoɔ asafo wɔ yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.

Anuanom, ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa sɛdeɛ ɛfata, mo nti, ɛfiri sɛ mo gyidie nyini boro so, na dɔ a mo nyinaa mode dodɔ mo ho mmaako mmaako no mu adɔ. Mo boasetɔ ne gyidie a mokura mu, mo taa nyinaa ne amaneɛ a momiaa mo ani hunuiɛ no mu nti, ɛma yɛn ara yɛhoahoa yɛn ho ma mo wɔ Nyankopɔn asafo no mu. Ɛno na ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn atɛntenenee agyiraeɛ, sɛ wɔbɛbu mo sɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie a mohunu ho amaneɛ no fata mo.

Ɛfiri sɛ ɛtene Nyankopɔn anim sɛ ɔde ahohia tua wɔn a wɔhiahia mo ho no ka, na wama mo a wɔhiahia mo ho no ne yɛn ahome, ɛda a wɔbɛyi Awurade Yesu ne ne tumi abɔfoɔ adie afiri soro, ogyaframa mu, na watɔ wɔn a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn, na wɔantie yɛn Awurade Yesu asɛmpa no were. Wɔn na wɔbɛnya akatua a ɛyɛ daa ɔsɛeɛ, ne yi a wɔyi wɔn firi Awurade anim ne ne tumi animuonyam ho, ɛberɛ a ɛbɛba sɛ wɔnhyɛ no animuonyam n’ahotefoɔ mu. Na wɔnhwɛ n’anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔagye adie nyinaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔagye yɛn adanseɛ a yɛdii mo no adi, ɛda no ara mu.
Enti nso, yɛbɔ mpaeɛ ma mo daa, sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn mmu mo sɛ mosɛ ɔfrɛ no, na ɔmfa tumi so mma n’ayamyɛ anisɔdeɛ ne gyidie adwuma nyɛ ma, na wɔahyɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu din animuonyam wɔ mo mu, ne mo nso wɔ ne mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo adom no teɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
